answer: We formulate mechanisms using dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect punishment matrices, employing staking collateral, slashing penalties, and zero-knowledge verifiable delay to block identity multiplication. Creating a huge capital barrier as a deep canyon bounded by a steep terrace, this design forces expected Sybil utility to plummet like a comet toward strictly negative values. This barrier analysis yields strict Nash equilibrium convergence in hostile multiagent environments, proving negative attack utility and robust Sybil resistance.
